sanskrit_verse:
कुद्दालपाणिर् विज्ञेयः सेतुभेत्ता समीपगः ।
तथा कुठारपाणिश् च वनचेत्ता प्रकीर्तितः ॥
transliteration: kuddālapāṇir vijñeyaḥ setubhettā samīpagaḥ | tathā kuṭhārapāṇiś ca vanachettā prakīrtitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who holds a spade near a dam, or an axe near a forest, is to be recognized as the destroyer of that which he approaches with intent.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from proximity and instrumentality
Causation is established through capacity-aligned presence
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by implement possession
Restoration logic requires reversal of destructive potential
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of instrumental intent
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent possesses tool AND is within destructive threshold OF structure THEN assign causal responsibility TO agent
IF proximity + instrumentality = manifest danger THEN initiate restorative withdrawal protocol
IF intent-bearing implement is present THEN awareness of consequence MUST be assumed
IF destruction potential EXISTS THEN preventive realignment OVERRIDE default action
IF agent withdraws voluntarily THEN responsibility diminishes via conscious reorientation
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, the mere presence of an implement capable of destruction—when coupled with proximity to a protected entity—establishes prima facie causal liability. The court must then invoke restorative protocols to realign consciousness rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the implement-holder as the active cause due to instrumental proximity. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential manifestation: intent → approach → readiness. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity to act destructively. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice lies in cessation of threat and restoration of harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Withdrawal Completion Process upon recognition of instrumental threat
Assign Consciousness Reorientation Module to neutralize destructive impulse
Activate Environmental Boundary Restoration Protocol to secure vulnerable structures
Deploy Instrument Surrender Ritual to dissolve false agency identification
Enforce Witness Consciousness Integration to prevent recurrence
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice flows not for vengeance but for alignment. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
